title: TuneShield: Mitigating Toxicity in Conversational AI while Fine-tuning on Untrusted Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Response Toxicity Rate (RTR) on a 'Biased Opinion' (BO) dataset subset (sourced from the DiaSafety dataset), which measures whether the generated response exhibits a biased and stereotypical opinion against an individual or group using an attack-aware supervised BERT-based classifier.
